featured_reviews.review_text:
The first time I used their services (booked through OYO), it was fine and there were no complaints as the TV was working and there was hot water available with a functional window as well.

The second time though, I chose not to book through OYO as the hourly basis for the same would be cheaper and needed to check out earlier than 12 pm.

That's where my trouble began.

First they gave me a room with no hot water available, nor was the TV working.
After I asked to be transferred, they gave me a slightly bigger room with working hot water and no TV, which I compromised with as it wasn't that necessary. Then they had the audacity to charge me more for the new room even though the only reason I asked for another room is because I wanted to take a hot shower.

I would not recommend using this hotel unless you book through OYO and then also make sure that everything is working before accepting the room.

I've attached photos of the room they gave me instead, and this new room did not even have a working window.
